B.label: B
B.statement: The extension class is referenced but never defined. quantifiers.domains.D3 (line 75) is 'triples satisfying every clause (a)-(f) of extension_predicate' with definition_ref: extension_predicate (line 76), and conclusion.statement_formal (line 209) ends '...satisfying every clause of extension_predicate'. The document has no top-level `extension_predicate` key: a YAML parse finds 43 top-level keys and none of them is extension_predicate, while the token occurs 4 times in the text. The core predicate of a class whose class id ends in C2 cannot be an undefined reference.
B.correlated: Same defect independently recorded by deepseek-flash-18 as HF-A1; not double-charged, this entry is the reviewer's own re-check at this hash.
B.remedy: Publish the extension_predicate block (name, frozen_regularity C2, frozen_equation_concept classical_ricci, frozen_direction future, definition with clauses (a)-(f), must_not_conflate). The frozen copy already carries such a block (artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml#e9fcefe6e595); it satisfies gate R18.
B.falsifier: A YAML parse of the reviewed hash returns a non-empty top-level extension_predicate mapping that D3.definition_ref resolves to, and check_class_schema.py R18 no longer fails on it.

gate_scope_findings.label: B
gate_scope_findings.statement: The canonical published artifact and the frozen manifest artifact for AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN are DIFFERENT files: schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml is rev3, sha256 23fec0e9cd68 (spec v1.1, FAILS the frozen gate), while FROZEN.json revision 19 binds this class to artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml, rev8, sha256 e9fcefe6e595 (PASSES the frozen gate). The map's G-FORM criteria/evidence_refs cite schemas/*.yaml; P5 requires canonical paths to stay schemas/ + research_map/ with the authoring tree mirroring at publish. Neither file satisfies both: the canonical hash fails the gate, the passing hash is not canonical and has no reviewer verdict bound to it (P4). A gate adjudicated on either does not bind the other.
gate_scope_findings.remedy: One binding action, not a rewrite loop: publish the gate-passing content to schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml, emit the artifact event with the new sha256, regenerate FROZEN.json from published canonical hashes, and re-bind one A1 verdict to that hash. Until then the C2 leg of G-FORM cannot close.
gate_scope_findings.falsifier: sha256(schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml) == sha256(artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml) == the FROZEN.json entry, and at least one A1 verdict cites that single hash.

gate_scope_findings.label: B
gate_scope_findings.statement: The frozen copy reintroduces a defect already adjudicated as blocking on revision 2. Its quantifiers.formal ranges 'forall (s,delta) in D0' and quantifiers.domains.D0 is defined as 'admissible regularity pairs: Sobolev variant s > 2.5 and delta in (0.5,1), or the smooth-with-decay default'. That is the disjunctive two-regularity domain lead-audit reopened revision 2 for (recorded in the canonical rev3 review_history line 390 and binding_note line 25: a disjunctive D0 'making the artifact a family of two class statements'), and it contradicts G-FORM's one-data-space criterion and the canonical rev3 text (lines 110-119: one frozen class H^4_{1/2+epsilon}, 'no second regularity setting'). The frozen lexical gate passes rev8 (R27 checks only that an exists-G pattern is present), so this is a semantic escape of exactly the kind the reviewer flagged as F-10 in the prior round. P2 says a prior finding counts as B only if still present at the reviewed hash; it is NOT present at 23fec0e9 (rev3 froze one class), so it is recorded here as gate-scope and NOT charged to the reviewed artifact.
gate_scope_findings.remedy: In the single P3 revision: restore the single frozen data class (rev3 lines 110-119 already contain the correct text), remove the (s,delta) family from quantifiers.formal and D0, then publish to the canonical path and re-run the gate. If the lead instead intends a family of classes, the class id must change and G-FORM's one-data-space criterion must be amended by the controller.
gate_scope_findings.falsifier: The published canonical hash has exactly one regularity setting in quantifiers.domains (no disjunctive pair set) and its quantifiers.formal contains no (s,delta) binder, confirmed by a YAML parse rather than by the lexical gate.
